scripts.build: pnpm --filter @openwisdom/schema build && pnpm --filter @openwisdom/providers build && pnpm --filter @openwisdom/catalog build && pnpm --filter @openwisdom/core build && pnpm --filter openwisdom build && node ./scripts/run-if-package.mjs packages/mcp "pnpm --filter openwisdom-mcp build" && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @openwisdom/schema test && pnpm --filter @openwisdom/providers test && pnpm --filter @openwisdom/core test && pnpm --filter openwisdom test && node ./scripts/run-if-package.mjs packages/mcp "pnpm --filter openwisdom-mcp test"
